chunks.arabic_text: أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْعَاصِمِيّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْجَهْمِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامِ قَالَ

translations.en: Abu Abdillah al-Asimi, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Ali ibn Asbat, from al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
translations.ur: ابو عبداللہ العاصمی، علی بن الحسن سے، علی بن اسباط سے، حسن بن الجهم سے، ابو الحسن الرضا (علیه السلام) سے روایت ہے کہ انہوں نے فرمایا:
translations.tr: Ebu Abdillah el-Asmî, Ali ibn el-Hasan'dan, Ali ibn Esbat'tan, el-Hasan ibn el-Cehm'den, Ebu el-Hasen er-Rıza (aleyhisselam)'dan; şöyle dedi:
translations.fa: ابو عبدالله عاصمی، از علی بن حسن، از علی بن اسباط، از حسن بن جهم، از ابو الحسن الرضا (علیه السلام) که فرمود:
translations.id: Abu Abdillah al-Asimi, dari Ali bin al-Hasan, dari Ali bin Asbat, dari al-Hasan bin al-Jahm, dari Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (alamah), yang berkata:
translations.bn: আবু আবদিল্লাহ আল-আসিমী, আলী ইবনুল হাসান হতে, আলী ইবন আসবাত হতে, আল-হাসান ইবনুল জাহম হতে, আবু আল-হাসান আল-রিদা (আলাইহিস সালাম) হতে, তিনি বলেন:
translations.es: Abu Abdillah al-Asimi, de Ali ibn al-Hasan, de Ali ibn Asbat, de al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm, de Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (que la paz sea con él), quien dijo:

chunks.arabic_text: ذُكِرَ عِنْدَهُ أَصْحَابُنَا وَذُكِرَ الْعَقْلُ، فَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: لَا يُعْبَأُ بِأَهْلِ الدِّينِ مِمَّنْ لَا عَقْلَ لَهُ، قُلْتُ: جَعَلَنِي فَدَاكَ، إِنَّ مِمَّنْ يَصِفُ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ قَوْمًا لَا بَأْسَ بِهِمْ عِنْدَنَا وَلَيْسَتْ لَهُمْ تِلْكَ الْعُقُولُ، فَقَالَ: لَيْسَ هَؤُلَاءِ مِمَّنْ خَاطَبَ اللَّهُ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الْعَقْلَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: اِقْبَلْ، فَاقْبَلَ، وَقَالَ لَهُ: أَدْبِرْ، فَأَدْبَرَ، فَقَالَ: وَعِزَّتِي وَجَلَالِي مَا خَلَقْتُ شَيْئًا أَحْسَنَ مِنْكَ أَوْ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ مِنْكَ، بِكَ آخُذُ وَبِكَ أَعْطِي

translations.en: Our companions were mentioned in his presence and the intellect was mentioned, so he (peace be upon him) said: Consideration is not given to a man of religion who has no intellect. I said: May I be your ransom, among those who describe this affair (Wilaya) are some people who are good in our eyes but do not possess that level of intellect, so he said: These are not the ones addressed by Allah, verily Allah created the intellect and said to it: 'Draw near,' so it drew near, and said to it: 'Turn back,' so it turned back, then He said: By My power and majesty, I have not created anything better than you or more beloved to me than you; by you do I take and by you do I give.

en.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) emphasizes the supreme status of the intellect (al-'aql) in religion, stating that a person of faith without intellect is disregarded. He explains that the intellect was the first creation addressed by Allah, obeying His commands to 'draw near' and 'turn back,' and declares it more beloved to Allah than any other creation, serving as the means by which Allah takes and gives.
en.seo_question: What is the significance of the intellect (al-'aql) in Shia theology according to Imam al-Rida?

key_terms.بك آخذ وبك أعطي: By you I take and by you I give
